project-nessie:rest-spec-support:current.notes: Serves tables and views over Iceberg REST with S3 request signing and vended credentials, layered on Nessie's git-like branching (branch/tag selected via the IRC prefix).
caveats: Iceberg REST support is officially flagged experimental
GCS and ADLS object-store support is experimental (S3 is stable)
Table locations are mandated by Nessie, and only the snapshot matching the Nessie commit is exposed

project-nessie:v2-spec-support:current.notes: Format v2 Iceberg tables are the baseline for Nessie-managed tables across Spark, Flink, Trino and other Iceberg clients.

project-nessie:v3-spec-support:current.notes: No official statement on format v3 tables through Nessie's Iceberg REST endpoint yet.

project-nessie:managed-offering:current.notes: Managed only as the engine inside Dremio Cloud; there is no standalone managed Nessie SaaS.

project-nessie:serves-own-irc:current.notes: Serves Iceberg REST with branch and merge semantics.

project-nessie:rw-foreign-irc:current.notes: No bundled query engine, so the catalog cannot itself read or write foreign tables over IRC: foreign-table access needs separate compute.
caveats: The source rubric scores 'no engine' as 0 (BYO compute), so this is recorded as not supported rather than unknown

project-nessie:multi-engine-multi-cloud:.notes: Strong with Dremio and Spark; narrower engine reach than Polaris.
